The '''1985–86 Serie A''' season was won by [[Juventus FC|Juventus]].

==Teams==
[[Pisa Calcio|Pisa]], [[US Lecce|Lecce]] and [[AS Bari|Bari]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]]. They all will be relegated and as of 2025-26 season, the only time in history that all promoted teams were relegated in Serie A.

==Events==
Italy arrived at the top of the [[UEFA ranking]].
